text_block_list.name: Acute & Falco
text_block_list.text: Today I'm making you my witness! ♪

text_block_list.name: Acute & Falco
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hmmm hm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all! We'll run and sing our
hearts out
next time too, so you better
be here to see it! I'll
be waiting for
you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(She's truly incredible... What's so
different
between the two of us?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice the lights on in the dance studio
despite
curfew approaching, so I peer
inside to see what's
happening.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A one, two, three, four. ♪ Two, two,
three,
four. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Trainer? Hehe, thank you kindly
for the
compliment, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute stops short, so I imagine
that
something must be bothering her. I
ask what's on
her mind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, I performed with Falco at
a fan
event.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We danced the same routine, but Falco
had this
brilliant glow about her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It seems that despite all the practice I've
put in, I
still have a lot of room for
improvement...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I need to practice even harder to make
sure I put
on a great show. I've got all
my fans out there
cheering for me, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing her up close, I honestly find
it hard
to fault anything about Wonder
Acute's dancing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she really feels there's such a big gap
between
her and Smart Falcon, I wonder
if...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, it does take me some time to
learn
the routines, but I'm good at this
kind of thing. I
suppose I do enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You mean I should show everyone that
I'm having
fun?
choice_data_list: それをもっと伝えるといいのかも
choice_data_list_en: Maybe it'd be good to convey that more.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, it did appear
that Falco
was enjoying the performance
more than
anybody.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess... that would explain why she
looked so
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess... that would explain why she
looked so
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me. When you put it like that,
it's a
little embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still... I see your point. Being up there in
front of
a crowd is a lot of fun...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I should make it clear to everyone how
happy I
am when they're enjoying the
show.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Wonder Acute has made a

breakthrough. Her performances
improve
noticeably afterward.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. In that case, would you be a dear
and help
me out?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was starting to get lonely dancing all
by myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'd have a lot more fun with a
dance
partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite having two left feet, I accept
Wonder
Acute's invitation, and we have
some fun dancing
together.
